probes.check: am_probe_flecs_diagnostics(): the installed OS API has the facade's log_, abort_ and perf_trace_push_, and a warning flecs logs reaches the facade.

seeded_violation.description: Leave flecs's default log function, which writes to standard error, in the OS API.

adaptation_notes: log_ maps flecs's levels to the facade's: fatal and error to error, warning to warn, info to info, debug and trace to trace.
abort_ reports to the facade's assert handler, then aborts: flecs calls it after logging the failed assertion, and doesn't expect it to return.
perf_trace_push_ and perf_trace_pop_ open and close facade zones, so a profiler in the profiling slot sees them; flecs calls them only when built with FLECS_PERF_TRACE, which the port's build isn't.
